title: Wire MemoryIndex.ByReference/ByConflict into live reverse-reference lookups
description:
## G-1 (from kb-graph-rag-audit)

MemoryIndex.ById, .ByTag, and .ByReference are populated on every Add/Remove/Rebuild call but have zero read call sites. Meanwhile both real reverse-reference features (GetReverseReferencesAsync and the inline context-pack builder) independently call _store.LoadAll() and linearly scan every record. Fix this.

### Detailed Steps
1. Add `ByConflict` to `MemoryIndex` (currently only `ByReference` exists; Conflicts isn't indexed at all)
2. Replace `GetReverseReferencesAsync`'s O(n) scan with `_index.ByReference.GetValueOrDefault(id)` (+ `ByConflict`), falling back to scan only if index is stale
3. Replace the inline `reverseRefMap` construction in context-pack path with a call to the same method
4. Add a test that edits a record's References, then immediately queries reverse-references, proving index stays live-consistent
